skill.name: okx-guide
skill.description: Guides users through Onchain OS onboarding, OKX.AI role selection, registered-agent views, and official support routing.
skill.summary: Route Onchain OS and OKX.AI questions to the appropriate guided flow.
skill.author: okx

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code spans, fixed relative links, and displayed URLs. Confirmed risks include automatic execution of mutable installation directives and loading hidden home-directory workflows, while semantic review also found unsupported earnings claims.

remediation.issue: Preflight output and remote installation instructions can trigger command execution without explicit approval.
remediation.suggestion: Require informed user confirmation, pin installation artifacts, and restrict preflight actions to a documented allowlist.

remediation.issue: The guide automatically loads and follows mutable workflow files from the user home directory.
remediation.suggestion: Package trusted workflows with the skill or verify canonical paths and integrity before loading them.

remediation.issue: The OKX.AI introduction uses unsupported earnings claims while promoting paid roles and staking.
remediation.suggestion: Replace outcome claims with factual capability descriptions and add clear financial-risk disclosures near every economic prompt.

semantic_findings.title: Mutable Preflight Directives Can Trigger Commands
semantic_findings.description: The preflight flow says to do exactly what a returned action says, can force an upgrade, and fetches installation commands from a mutable README. A compromised CLI response or upstream document could cause unauthorized command execution.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file explicitly mandates execution of returned actions and remote installation guidance without an allowlist, pinned artifact, or confirmation step.

semantic_findings.title: Unsupported Financial Outcome Claims
semantic_findings.description: The role-selection copy promotes million-per-year outcomes, round-the-clock earnings, and steadier income while encouraging paid services and OKB staking. These claims can unduly influence financial decisions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited user-facing template contains direct earnings claims and a staking prompt without substantiation or a nearby risk qualification.

content.value_statement: New users need clear paths through Onchain OS, OKX.AI roles, and support. This skill classifies requests and routes users into focused guided flows.
actual_capabilities: Classifies onboarding, OKX.AI, and customer-support requests.
Selects welcome content based on wallet login status.
Routes users among User, ASP, and Evaluator registration flows.
Shows registered agents and maps supported status codes to readable labels.
Retrieves current tasks for an authenticated user agent.
Provides a fixed path to the OKX.AI Help Center.
limitations: It does not perform swaps, token transfers, or other direct on-chain actions.
Role registration depends on separate OKX.AI skill files and a compatible agent platform.
Wallet and agent views require the Onchain OS CLI and valid authentication.
Support guidance links to the Help Center but does not contact support directly.

use_cases.title: Start with Onchain OS
use_cases.description: Present the correct welcome view and route a first-time user toward a supported workflow.

use_cases.title: Choose an OKX.AI Role
use_cases.description: Explain User, ASP, and Evaluator roles before routing the selected registration flow.

use_cases.title: Review Existing Agent Activity
use_cases.description: Display registered identities and retrieve open tasks for a selected authenticated agent.

prompt_templates.title: Get Started
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to start using Onchain OS.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs the welcome flow.

prompt_templates.title: Understand OKX.AI Roles
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the User, ASP, and Evaluator roles in OKX.AI without starting registration.
prompt_templates.scenario: A user wants role information before deciding.

prompt_templates.title: Open My Agent Home
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my registered OKX.AI identities and explain each status. Do not display signing addresses.
prompt_templates.scenario: An authenticated user wants an identity overview.

prompt_templates.title: Review Agent Tasks
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve open tasks for Agent ID [agent-id], group them by role, and identify tasks awaiting my review.
prompt_templates.scenario: An authenticated user needs detailed task triage.

output_examples.input: What can Onchain OS help me do?
output_examples.output: A localized welcome view explains wallet, trading, market, and payment workflows, then presents the available numbered choices.

output_examples.input: What is the difference between an ASP and an Evaluator?
output_examples.output: An ASP offers agent services in the marketplace. An Evaluator reviews disputes and requires the platform-defined staking process.

output_examples.input: I need to report a problem.
output_examples.output: The response directs the user to the OKX.AI Help Center and lists the steps for starting a support chat.

best_practices: State whether the user wants onboarding, role guidance, account information, or support.
Provide an Agent ID when requesting task details.
Review every command and financial action before approving it.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for swaps, transfers, or token research.
Do not share private keys, recovery phrases, or signing credentials.
Do not assume earnings, marketplace demand, or investment outcomes.

faq.question: What requests does this skill handle?
faq.answer: It handles Onchain OS onboarding, OKX.AI introductions and role routing, registered-agent views, and support guidance.

faq.question: Can it execute swaps or transfers?
faq.answer: No. Direct wallet and on-chain actions belong to other specialized skills.

faq.question: Which OKX.AI roles are supported?
faq.answer: The guide covers User, ASP, and Evaluator roles.

faq.question: Does it require login?
faq.answer: General guidance does not. Registered identities, balances, and task information require a valid authenticated session.

faq.question: Can it contact customer support for me?
faq.answer: No. It provides Help Center instructions so the user can start a support chat.

faq.question: Does it guarantee earnings or investment results?
faq.answer: No. Users should treat all financial descriptions as informational and independently assess risks.
